title: SDKB — Semiconductor Domain Knowledge Base (paper release)

creators.name: Park, HyoungSik
creators.affiliation: Sungkyunkwan University, Graduate School of Management of Technology

description:
SDKB is a provenance-grounded semiconductor domain ontology dataset carrying expert matching, prior-art search and technology foresight as task views on one shared schema (T-Box). This release is the frozen state accompanying the SDKB prior-art paper.

Contents. Shared T-Box and task views (OWL/TTL), SHACL shapes, 31 competency questions, concept mappings, provenance records with per-file SHA-256 for all published assets, and benchmark/ — the evaluation harness (retrieval systems, release-gate conditions, scoring and statistics) together with frozen evaluation assets: query and relevance-judgment identifiers, split boundaries, frozen thresholds, gate reports, fault-injection matrices and result tables.

Licensing. This deposit is dual-licensed and therefore does not map to a single identifier. Data layers (ontology, mappings, validation shapes, queries, provenance) are released under CDLA-Permissive-2.0; code (generators, release chain, evaluation harness) is released under Apache-2.0; documentation under CC-BY-4.0. See LICENSE.txt and LICENSE-CODE.txt in the archive.

Not included. Patent full text is not redistributable under the terms of the source database; identifiers and a refetch procedure are provided instead. Known reproduction limits are stated in benchmark/README.md.
